card.name: Capital U starting a medical word
card.fires_on: The capital letter U at the start of a word, mostly in all-caps label text. It begins words such as uterine, ulcers, untreated, uricosuric or Ursa.

modes.label: All-caps warning text
modes.description: U begins a word like UTERINE, ULCERS or UNTREATED in capitalized label warnings.
modes.example: THE RISK OF<< U>>TERINE RUPTURE INCREASES

modes.label: Uricosuric heading
modes.description: U begins Uricosuric in headings or sentence starts in interaction sections.

modes.label: Non-drug word
modes.description: U begins a name outside labels, such as a constellation.
modes.example: Earth's NCP currently lies in<< U>>rsa Minor, near the star Polaris

card.plain: It fires on a capital U that opens a word, often in warnings printed in all capitals.
